list.name: node_id
list.label: node_id
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
union(tables: [
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "waveform_1s", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r._field == "frames"),
  schema.tagValues(bucket: "telemetry", tag: "node_id", start: -1d,
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "dt_ns")
])
  |> group()
  |> unique()
  |> sort()

list.name: phase
list.label: Phase
list.query: 3-phase : total, Phase A : a, Phase B : b, Phase C : c

panels.title: Status

targets.query:
union(tables: [
  from(bucket: "telemetry")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "dt_ns")
    |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time"]),
  from(bucket: "waveform")
    |> range(start: -1h)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "sequence")
    |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time"])
])
  |> group()
  |> max(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))

targets.query:
import "math"
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r.subsystem == "ptp_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "locked" or r._field == "state" or r._field == "offset_ns")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value:
      if r.locked == 1.0 then 2.0
      else if r.state == 2.0 and math.abs(x: r.offset_ns) < 100000.0 then 1.0
      else 0.0}))

panels.description: Locked: the node's servo has held within 1 us of the grandmaster for 8 Syncs (needed for cross-node comparisons). Tracking: servo running within 100 us. Unlocked: otherwise.

panels.title: Completeness

targets.query:
import "array"
received = (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -65s, stop: -5s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "frames")
  |> sum()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
lo = (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -65s, stop: -5s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "first_index")
  |> min()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
hi = (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -65s, stop: -5s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "first_index")
  |> max()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value + (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -65s, stop: -5s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "daq2_packet" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field == "frames")
  |> last()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._value
array.from(rows: [{_value: 100.0 * float(v: received) / float(v: hi - lo)}])

panels.description: Data completeness: frames stored in InfluxDB as a share of frames the node acquired over the minute to 5 s ago, from the packet frame indices.

panels.title: Power: ${phase:text}

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waveform_1s")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power" and r.node_id == "${node_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p_${phase}" or r._field == "s_${phase}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field =~ /^p_/ then "Real power (P)" else "Apparent power (S)"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.description: Real power P = mean(v x i), with each current interpolated to its voltage's sampling instant, and apparent power S = Vrms x Irms, per second (IEEE 1459). Uncalibrated until the shield's gains are calibrated.

panels.title: Voltage ${measure:text} (phase to earth): ${phase:text}

targets.query:
import "strings"
import "math"
import "regexp"
peak = "${measure}" == "peak"
fields = regexp.compile(v: "^" + (if "${phase}" == "total" then "[abc]" else "${phase}")
                           + (if peak then "_(min|max)$" else "_rms$"))
from(bucket: "waveform_1s")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field =~ fields)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with
      _value: if peak then math.abs(x: r._value) else r._value * r._value,
      _field: "phase_" + strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 0, end: 1)}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: if peak then max else mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if peak or not exists r._value then r._value else math.sqrt(x: r._value)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.description: Per-phase voltage, RMS or peak, for the phase selected at the top. With the default shield profile the phases are measured to earth, not neutral.

panels.title: Voltage: ${phase:text}

targets.query:
import "regexp"
phases = regexp.compile(v: if "${phase}" == "total" then "^[abc]$" else "^${phase}$")
stop = (from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field =~ phases)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> min(column: "_time")
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0))._time
start = time(v: int(v: stop) - 100000000)
from(bucket: "waveform")
  |> range(start: start, stop: time(v: int(v: stop) + 1))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "voltage" and r.node_id == "${node_id}" and r._field =~ phases)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0, _field: "phase_" + r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["node_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with t_ms: float(v: int(v: r._time) - int(v: start)) / 1000000.0}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "node_id"])
